prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated top-performing wins in adoption redesigns and home wait_info.
Adding new screens to the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently degraded performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, while home redesigns (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Updating home wait_info frequently yielded wins (5 wins out of 17 tests), though many tests produced no clear effect.
Finish copy (5 tests), finish layout (3 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and choose_path layout (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or conflicting for change types with only one test or mixed outcomes, such as finish redesigns and sign-in reordering.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story-Scroll Path Stage Experience: Redesigns the path selection screen into a fluid story-scroll visual layout connecting journey options directly with interactive path preview cards. (why: The choose_path step has a 20.5% dropoff rate and a high mean completion time of 514s.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Multi-Angle Creator Flow: Rebuilds photo upload into a multi-angle photo picker flow with live visual preview feedback before submission. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption stage takes median 89s / mean 1017s.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Pick Friend Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a stage layout featuring companion selection cards and trait badges. (why: Adoption stage redesigns have historically generated high conversion gains and streamline selection.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence: Reorders sign_in to occur right after adoption_certificate and before waiting screen generation. (why: Sign-in drops 24.9% of users early; moving sign-in after character adoption capitalizes on user commitment while safeguarding account sync.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Render Time Remaining Tracker: Adds an explicit time estimate countdown timer and progress indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen has a very long mean duration of 2336s, and updating wait_info on home frequently yields conversion wins.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Desktop Notification: Enables a system desktop notification alert option on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Users face median 201s waiting times; notification callouts allow users to safely switch windows while waiting.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Storage Persistence Copy: Updates sign_in screen headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that account creation saves pets from being reset or lost. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Interaction & Control Hint: Adds a high-visibility interaction tip to the home_intro screen explaining basic desktop pet controls and tray options. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
8: [finish, layout] Spotlight Home Intro Celebration Layout: Updates home_intro layout to spotlight view featuring a playful mascot celebration component. (why: The finish step has a 29.1% dropoff rate; upgrading the final screen visual hierarchy encourages final completion.)

scores.note: Choose_path has a 20.5% dropoff; choose_path redesigns historically average a +2.2% lift across 4 tests.
Both support emails and funnel time point to custom photo issues, but adding new flows/screens consistently degrades conversion.
Adoption redesigns are top performers with an average +5.7% lift across 5 tests.
Sign_in drops 24.9% of users, but reordering steps has a negative historical average (-1.1% across 6 tests).
Home wait_info updates frequently yield wins (5 out of 17 tests, +1.2% avg) and are simple configuration changes.
Notification changes across stages tend to underperform, and native desktop notification triggers require full release work.
High dropoff at sign-in plus 8 support emails give strong evidence, though copy updates historically yield low overall lift.
Finish step loses 29.1% of users and support tickets confirm confusion, but finish hints have historically degraded conversion (-4.4%).
Targeting the finish stage addresses the largest dropoff (29.1%), but layout updates in finish yield minimal positive lift (+0.4% avg).
